description: Use this when the user wants to change when or how they take a product that is already in their stack. Replaces that product's schedule: time-of-day amounts, daily, specific-days or every-other-day timing, as-needed, with food, and timing notes.

as_needed.description: Whether the product is taken as needed (true/false). Omit to keep the current value.

attribute_change_requested.description: Set true ONLY when the user asked to change with_food or as_needed. Without it, a with_food/as_needed value that differs from the current one is rejected.

every_other_day_start.description: When to start every_other_day schedule: "today" or "tomorrow"

new_daily_amount.description: ONLY when the user explicitly asked to take a different amount per day: the new daily total they asked for, in the same units as the schedule. Must equal the schedule total. Omit for timing changes — a schedule whose total differs from the current daily amount is rejected without it.

schedule.description: JSON array of time-slot assignments, e.g. [{"activity":"morning","units":2},{"activity":"bedtime","units":1}]. "units" is in the product's serving unit as user_schedule shows it (capsules, tablets, scoops, mL, ...) — NOT servings. For a tincture whose serving_size is 0.7 mL, one serving is 0.7, not 1. Valid activities: morning, midday, evening, bedtime, workout, unscheduled.

schedule_days.description: Array of day names (e.g. ["monday","wednesday","friday"]) for specific_days schedule_type

schedule_notes.description: Brief timing instructions that the schedule cannot capture (e.g., "take 2 hours apart from calcium", "take on empty stomach 30 min before bed"). Set to empty string to clear.

schedule_type.description: Schedule type: daily, specific_days, or every_other_day

with_food.description: Whether the product should be taken with food (true/false). Omit to keep the current value.

name: suppco_update_product_schedule
title: Update product schedule
